text: In the Liénard–Wiechert fields of a moving point charge, the acceleration (radiation) field that transports energy to infinity falls off with distance R from the retarded source position as:
explanation: The acceleration field is proportional to 1/R, so the power through a sphere (area ∝ R² times |E|² ∝ 1/R²) stays finite as R→∞ and energy escapes to infinity. The velocity (Coulomb) field falls as 1/R² and stays attached to the charge, carrying no net energy away; 1/R³ is the static dipole falloff.
